## What’s New in 5.0.0

### All editions

- **Import history from logs** recovers missing Main-server Safari runs and sparklings for your **History UUID**. Copy logs from your old Safari runs into the current Minecraft instance’s logs folder first. The importer can link midnight rollovers and preserves live-recorded runs when a log matches.
- **Stats** shows Doomspiral and Wumpa checks. Use `!doom` or `!dooms`, `!wumpa` or `!wumpas`, and `!gemzie` for recorded encounter counts in party chat.
- **Stats** separates recorded run time from `/playtimedetailed` and refreshes **API Captures** and biome totals when opened. Lifetime capture achievements can unlock during a run using the last API total and newer personal captures.
- Open **Critterdex** from **Sparklings** to see all 37 critters by biome, rarity, credited catches, and dex tier. **Profit** has a **New session** button, and `/sm history import` uses the same flow as **Import logs** in settings.
- Reopening `/playtimedetailed` refreshes the saved Safari playtime. Vincent’s **Dye Guide** syncs your Emerald Dye total from the **You’ve dropped** line when it is available.

#### Party sync

- Expand confirmed growing parties on a supporting provider's existing WebSocket, with replay gating and recovery.
- Mark confirmed visit departures and preserve same-visit state through temporary disconnects.
- Include initial food and coin grants in hotspot preference allocation and show recognized admission failure reasons in diagnostics.
- Contact the backup only after sustained primary failure and ignore delayed backup responses after the primary recovers.

### Full and Full No Auto Update

- Set per-critter choices separately under **Critter glow outlines** and **Critter boxes**.
- Optionally keep intact Rockmite mounds visible and continue highlighting remaining Sparkling checks after Unique biome completion. Both settings default to off.
- Glow-incompatible targets use a box fallback. Locally unpunched Forest nests retain their Full Clear markers after shared completion.

## Editions and updates

- Added **Standard**, **Full**, and **Full No Auto Update** builds from the same codebase for Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2, and 26.3.
- **Standard** includes shared Safari tracking, party sync, HUDs, and history with visible critter outlines, generic floor-drop highlights, and local sparkling alerts. Gameplay automation and hidden-target highlights are excluded.
- **Full** keeps the original gameplay features and adds a **Download Update** button and opt-in **Auto Update** toggle. Downloads match your edition and Minecraft version, are verified before installation, and install after Minecraft closes. Automatic downloads default off; failed installations retain a verified rollback copy and support retry.
- **Full No Auto Update** keeps Full's gameplay features without in-game update checks, downloads, or the installer.
- GitHub releases provide all three editions: Standard (unsuffixed), Full (`-full`), and Full No Auto Update (`-full-no-auto-update`). Modrinth publication is pending. Install only one edition and match its `+mc` suffix to your Minecraft version.

## Shared settings and Standard helpers

- All editions now share settings, HUD layouts, and Safari history within the same Minecraft instance. Missing saves are imported from the old Standard folder without overwriting existing shared saves. Standard preserves Full-only settings while leaving them inactive.
- Standard includes capsule trajectory previews, known Snoozle wall waypoints, and the Doomspiral lottery. Critter contacts in capsule previews and lottery results respect local visibility; trajectory geometry and fixed Snoozle wall waypoints can remain visible through terrain.
- Added Standard keybinds for **Invite Next Sparkling Player**, **Prepare Party Warp**, and **Accept Hideyho Quest**. Each press performs one action: invite an eligible player in priority order, prepare the warp command, or select the current quest prompt. Configure invite priorities under **Party → Interactions**.

## Party commands and customization

- Added `!sparkling [IGN]` for total, unique, and duplicate sparkling counts, and `!rates` for each responding player's session catches and runs per sparkling.
- Added a **Reset** tab to restore default settings and HUD layouts or disable configurable features without clearing saved Safari records.
- Added per-row progress HUD controls, including a timer-only display, and a master switch for custom critter names.
- Reorganized settings navigation and Standard's **Highlight Visible** controls to show the options available in that edition.

## Fixes

- Improved Warp List rank colors using party-roster and tab-list evidence.
- Corrected installed-release highlights so the What's New screen reflects the current upgrade and includes features from skipped releases.
- Updated release detection and download verification for the new Full filenames, and strengthened shipping checks for all nine GitHub JARs and their manifest.

- Added independent switches for HUD rows such as nests, bird food, feeder contents, podiums, Snoozle walls, Rockmite mounds, coins, and Gazers.

- Added a biome splits HUD for Unique and Full Clear runs, with configurable seconds, tenths, hundredths, or milliseconds.
- Added an optional current-session summary with average run time, run count, credited Sparklings, and runs per Sparkling when available.

- Added `!profit` with `session`, `lifetime`, `week`, or `day`; no argument defaults to the current session. Each responding mod user reports their recorded Safari profit, runs, and hourly rate when available, including whether values use sell offers or instant selling.
- Added `!captures [IGN]` for total and per-biome Safari capture counts. With no IGN, it looks up the sender.
- Individual `/sparkling` cards now include those capture totals and biome counts. Unavailable counts are reported as unavailable rather than invented as zero.
- Updated party-command help and player-name suggestions for the new commands.

## Ubik's Cube cooldown

- Added an opt-in Rift Split or Steal cooldown timer under **SkyBlock → Helpers**.
- Tracks the cooldown from the game menu or the server's wait message, saves it by player/profile, and retains it across relogs. The HUD supports placement and appearance settings; the feature defaults off.

- Added a feature highlights screen with curated descriptions of what changed and where to find the new controls.
- Tracks installed versions and unread highlights, including features from releases skipped during an upgrade. The bundled catalog works without fetching release notes and adapts to compact or wide screens.

## Capture tracking, ESP, and nameplates

- Improved capture-to-model matching for delayed server messages, repeated throws, slightly off-target throws, hidden chat, and models that disappear before confirmation. Captured critters retire from ESP without hiding unrelated nearby critters.
- Improved pity tracking across escapes and body/name-tag replacements, including Hideon critters and other capsule species. Ambiguous nearby critters no longer inherit each other's attempts, and capture-animation markers are matched to the relevant target.
- **Show catch pity now defaults off.** Existing saved preferences are preserved.
- Fixed Rockmite mound progress when hit messages are hidden or the player switches targets.
- Improved retained Shyworm head positioning and visibility while underground, including when glow ESP is enabled without Box ESP.

## Completion and personal bests

- Fixed Full Clear handling for species with known capture quotas, so leftover models do not keep verified quota completion pending. Eligible biome-clear reports can finish after leaving the biome.
- Corrected **Lake Cleared** timing: Unique and Sparkling modes require one personal catch of Tepid, Nozzlenose, and Mantis Shrimp; Full Clear waits for their full observed populations. Loot shares alone do not trigger the alert.
- Added **Local PB messages** controls for Doomspiral and Wumpa solo, duo, observed-solo, and observed-duo catches, plus Full Clear, Unique Run, and Party Unique Run biome records. These default on; hiding messages does not stop PB recording.
- PB feedback now shows the relevant best time in `(PB: …)` form and identifies new records.

## Hotspot party-run history

- Added a completed party-run count to the Hotspot HUD, backed by saved run history and the current party's UUIDs.
- Tracks whether Hotspot assigning was enabled, whether the roster was present together, and whether the reward summary was received. Roster refreshes, late summaries, and teammates leaving before the summary do not lose or double-count the recorded run.
- Party changes reset continuity; older or unconfirmed history is not guessed into the count.

## Recovery and presentation

- Fixed automatic reconnect handling for network/login failures and disconnects during server configuration. Retry backoff survives failed attempts; cancellation, intentional quits, and recognized non-retryable denials stop further retries.
- Refreshed the Doomspiral Lottery reveal with revised reel timing, a clear **SPARKLING / REGULAR** marquee, and animated critter-name styling.
- Added project credits and attribution links to the README.

Builds target **Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2, and 26.3**. Choose the JAR matching your Minecraft version.

## Fixes and improvements

- **Party discovery cache repairs:** existing successful profile/discovery reads now update current party members' cached discoveries. `/sparkling`, `/sparkling party`, `!missing` and scheduled personal stats can repair stale requirements without changing modes or making extra requests. - Bird Sparkling checks can recover missed spawn messages through a fresh qualified Forest scan: shared captures plus currently rendered birds must cover all known feeding opportunities, including known starting extras, with no floor or held food remaining. ## Honeyhive and chat fixes

- Nearby, unambiguously matched Honeyhive holograms now correct saved readiness: **Click to loot!** clears stale cooldowns, and **Refill in** updates the saved deadline even when an older loot timestamp or Queen Bee flag exists. Corrections persist across relogs and supply the fallback while out of range.
- A **two-second grace period** after confirmed loot/Queen Bee messages lets stale holograms catch up. Countdown rounding jitter is coalesced to avoid repeated configuration writes. Block honey levels do not determine readiness.
- Removed routine local downtime request/readiness/ticket/timeout/departure/reset notices and the contest-warning chat line. Entry-block explanations and Shift bypass, contest title/sound warnings, automatic party contest requests, combined party reminders and ticket-earned announcements retain their existing behavior.

- Added a movable, resizable **Doomspiral capsule throw tick timer**, enabled by default under Safari helpers → Capture tools.
- The Haunted stirring message starts a countdown using observed server ticks. Defaults are **98 emergence ticks** and a **4-tick throw lead**, producing a **94-tick countdown**. Both settings are adjustable and saved.
- The HUD appears within **10 blocks of a living, loaded warden**, continues counting while out of range, and shows **THROW NOW** at zero for up to 40 server ticks. A confirmed Doomspiral catch clears it.
